description: ML-DSA-87 public-key validation vectors. A key is weak unless at least minLargeCoefficients of its 2048 t1 coefficients are large. A coefficient v is large iff v lies in [largeLow, largeHighBelowHalf] or [largeLowAboveHalf, largeHigh]. All bounds derive from the parameter set: a large coefficient's contribution must exceed 3*GAMMA2 (two HighBits bands from zero, beyond hint correction) both as 2^D*v centered modulo q and, because 2^(D+1)*v centered modulo q can be small and odd for v near 512 while c times an all-odd polynomial is always even, as (2^(D+1)*v centered modulo q)/2. This gives [96, 415] and [608, 927]. minLargeCoefficients = OMEGA + 1 = 76, more such coefficients than the verifier accepts hints. zeroHintForgeryVerifies records whether the (z = 0, h = 0, c~ = H(mu || w1Encode(0))) signature verifies under the key at the FIPS 204 primitive; it must for the keys marked true, and validation must reject every key marked weak.

vectors.name: single coefficient 96
vectors.note: one large coefficient is not enough

vectors.name: single coefficient 992
vectors.note: 2^13*992 wraps to a small residue; forges with no hints

vectors.name: every coefficient 512
vectors.note: 2^13*512 = 2^-1*(2^13-1) mod q and c*(1+x+..+x^255) is always even; forges with no hints

vectors.name: 512 at even positions, 0 elsewhere
vectors.note: 2^-1 family on the (x+1)^254 pattern; forges for about half of all messages

vectors.name: 76 coefficients of 96
vectors.note: exactly the minimum, lower band edge

vectors.name: 76 coefficients of 415
vectors.note: exactly the minimum, below the 2^-1 window

vectors.name: 76 coefficients of 608
vectors.note: exactly the minimum, above the 2^-1 window

vectors.name: 76 coefficients of 927
vectors.note: exactly the minimum, upper band edge

vectors.name: seven polynomials of 512, one honest-looking
vectors.note: the 2^-1 family in seven polynomials, large coefficients in the eighth
